title: User Import
seo: User import and account migration without resets
meta: Move existing users from another system or a spreadsheet without making them start over. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: User import, bring people over without starting again
overview: Changing platforms should not mean asking every customer to sign up again. We move your users from the old system, a database export or a spreadsheet into your new accounts. We clean the data, match fields, remove duplicates, carry over passwords where the hash format allows, and otherwise send a friendly set-your-password email. We run a small test group first and give you a result report.

faq: Sometimes. If your old system used a standard hashing method like bcrypt, they can. If not, we cannot read passwords, and users are asked to set a new one through a friendly email.
Will users get lots of emails when I import them?
Only the ones you choose. We can import silently and email later in batches, with a message written by you. We avoid sending anything until you approve the wording.
What if my data is messy?
That is common. We clean spacing, capital letters and bad addresses, flag odd rows in the report and ask you about anything we cannot fix confidently.
Is it safe to hand you my user data?
We work inside your accounts wherever possible, delete any copies when finished and only use data to complete the order. Consider your own privacy policy when sharing personal data.
